address: Emirates Palace Mandarin Oriental Hotel, West Corniche Road, Al Ras Al Akhdar, Abu Dhabi
bio: It’s not every day that you get to sit in a luxurious beachside gazebo overlooking a grand Presidential Palace and a glistening Arabian Gulf, but this is exactly the appeal of this modern restaurant. Catch the sunset with a drink before enjoying tasty woodfire cooking. Take your pick of mouthwatering steaks, ‘Reef and Beef’ – their version of a surf and turf – or seafood platters if you plan to share. Finish off with a smoked chocolate mousse or fig tart. This is where to come for a romantic evening out.
